images.title: Horizon / Sunset silhouettes
images.note: Distinct rising silhouettes, luminous gaps, and violet distance haze create several readable depths.
images.credit: Guerrilla / Sony Interactive Entertainment · official PS5 capture

images.title: Horizon / Storm and landscape
images.note: A dominant storm mass shapes the scene. Illumination reaches through the air and agrees with the ground.
images.credit: Guerrilla / Sony Interactive Entertainment · official PS5 capture

images.title: Horizon / Close cloud flight
images.note: Close clouds can be soft. Strong large-scale cavities and connected volumes carry the shape.
images.credit: Guerrilla / Sony Interactive Entertainment · official PS5 capture

images.title: Flight Simulator 2024 / Asymmetric form
images.note: The hooked silhouette has a distinct identity. Fraying edges and quieter surrounding sky make it legible.
images.credit: JohnnyT5000 · official MSFS forum · self-reported live weather, no atmosphere add-ons

images.title: Flight Simulator 2024 / Layered sunset
images.note: Several cloud textures share the sky. Warm faces, cool undersides, and different apparent scales break uniformity.
images.credit: JohnnyT5000 · official MSFS forum · self-reported live weather, no atmosphere add-ons

images.title: Red Dead Redemption 2 / Golden landscape
images.note: Sparse low clouds, fine upper patterning, and warm haze connect the sky to the landscape. Study integration, not cloud sharpness.
images.credit: Rockstar Games · publisher Steam screenshot gallery

images.title: Red Dead Redemption 2 / Moonlit atmosphere
images.note: Cool air, receding silhouettes, and restrained warm lights establish night while preserving depth. Different conditions from Wrela’s twilight fixture.
images.credit: Rockstar Games · publisher Steam screenshot gallery

images.title: Real sky / Colorado congestus
images.note: A tall asymmetric body has several distinct growing tips and irregular gaps. An older photograph; use for form, not pixel sharpness.
images.credit: Kevin Larman · NASA S’COOL collection

images.title: Real sky / Cumulus over the Rockies
images.note: Strong vertical growth and varied outlines sit coherently over mountain terrain. A scanned photograph, not a calibrated color reference.
images.credit: Jeff Caplan / NASA · August 2001

images.title: Real sky / Cirrus above cumulus
images.note: Thin directional upper cloud differs clearly from the larger low cloud bodies. Multiple textures establish altitude separation.
images.credit: Doug Stoddard · Puerto Rico, March 2002 · NASA S’COOL

images.title: Real sky / Sunset cirrus
images.note: Fine warm streaks cross cooler blue air. The straight bright lines are aircraft contrails, not natural cirrus structure.
images.credit: Ed Donovan · South Carolina, July 2003 · NASA S’COOL

images.title: Real sky / Shadows across the atmosphere
images.note: Clouds near the horizon cast long shadows through the atmosphere. Light and dark regions remain visible beyond the cloud silhouettes.
images.credit: © Kurt Voigts · NASA APOD, August 11, 2010
